title: The Glitch That Changed Online Gaming

scenes.text: In 1999 a server bug broke World of Warcraft

scenes.label: OVERLOADED CHARACTER COUNT
scenes.text: The bug let players spawn unlimited characters on one account
scenes.query2: World of Warcraft character duplication bug

scenes.label: ECONOMY INFILTRATION
scenes.text: Exploited accounts flooded the in‑game auction house with items
scenes.query: World of Warcraft auction house inflation bug

scenes.label: PATCH THAT SHAPED MMOs
scenes.text: Blizzard’s emergency patch introduced server‑side validation still used today

description: A single server bug in 1999 forced a major MMO to rewrite its core systems. Discover how that glitch reshaped online gaming. Follow for more gaming glitch stories!
